stories.title: Why the data center you dread might never even be built
stories.summary: Before those challenges even come into play, though, there’s a more basic problem: A lot of the projects being announced may never get built in the first place. On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, hosts Rebecca Bellan and Tim De Chant are joined by Brent Nelson , senior managing director of markets and strategy at Ascend Analytics , to separate the data center projects that are likely to get built from the ones that may never get off the ground.
